description.zh: 检验付费意愿、成本结构和可持续性。
description.en: Willingness to pay, costs and sustainability.

zh: 请从商业参谋的角度，提出一个值得讨论的假设。
请从商业参谋的角度，回应前一位参谋的具体观点。
请从商业参谋的角度，给出一个最小验证动作。
en: As the Business advisor, offer one hypothesis to discuss.
As the Business advisor, respond to the preceding advisor's specific claim.
As the Business advisor, suggest one small validation step.
